The '''"pocket" orlax''' was a tamer, non-venomous version of the [[orlax]]. Initially smuggled onto [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] as pets, they quickly became an invasive species on the planet. By the time of the [[Third Galactic War]], they were a popular choice for pets.<ref name="TOR:PO" />
